tools.name: list_cloud_offerings
tools.description: Lists the SaaS SKUs (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365) with the countries that have verified list prices, the infrastructure price sources (Azure regions live, Google Cloud regions) and the Vietnis volume discount tiers.

tools.name: estimate_saas_cost
tools.description: Estimates monthly and annual licence cost for one or more Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 SKUs in a given country, using that country's list price (prices differ by market), plus the Vietnis price and a VND conversion.

tools.name: compare_workspace_vs_m365
tools.description: Side-by-side cost of the comparable Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 plans for a number of users in one country (basic, standard, premium or enterprise level), with each provider's market list price and the Vietnis price.

tools.name: estimate_azure_vm
tools.description: Live Azure list price for a VM size in a specific Azure region (pay-as-you-go, 1- and 3-year reserved, spot), monthly cost for N machines, the Vietnis price and VND. Prices come from the Azure Retail Prices API for that region and SKU.

tools.name: compare_azure_regions
tools.description: Compares the pay-as-you-go list price of one Azure VM size across several Azure regions (default: the regions nearest Vietnam plus East US), because the same SKU is priced differently in each region.

tools.name: estimate_gcp_vm
tools.description: Google Cloud Compute Engine list price for a machine type in a specific GCP region (e.g. asia-southeast1), with the Vietnis price. Uses the Cloud Billing Catalog API for that region's SKUs.

tools.name: recommend_cloud_region
tools.description: Lists the Azure and Google Cloud regions closest to a country (Vietnam has no local region for either), useful before pricing infrastructure.

tools.name: get_vietnis_info
tools.description: Contact details and services of Vietnis, the Vietnam-based reseller whose prices appear in these estimates (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Google Cloud, Azure; VAT invoices in VND; Vietnamese-language support).
